record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace tied embeddings with separate 96-dimensional input and output tables, retaining raw embedding norms. Add a jointly trained gated projection q=sigmoid(Wg h)*tanh(Wq h) for dot-product scoring against output embeddings. Jointly use Adam LR=0.0007, dropout=0.15, weight_decay=0.00001 and batch_size=256. Separate tables decouple recurrent inputs from ranking geometry; the gate and regularization constrain this extra flexibility. Preserve history handling, final-real-position readout, sampling and BPR.

category_rationales.rationale: Retain GRU recurrence and add a jointly trained gated scoring projection q=sigmoid(Wg h)*tanh(Wq h), shared by training and candidate inference. Preserve final-real-position readout. The generated predictor imports this updated class, so it restores the same projection parameters from each category's single checkpoint.

Couple the additional embedding and projection capacity with Adam learning rate 0.0007, dropout 0.15, weight decay 0.00001 and batch size 256. Preserve BPR, sampling, history length, epoch cap and batches per epoch. Require the supplied dataset directory explicitly.

Use separate, jointly trained 96-dimensional input and output embedding tables with raw norms. This decouples recurrent inputs from ranking geometry across all four datasets. Existing metadata records the width, and the predictor imports the updated model class and strictly restores both tables and the gated projection.
